For fixed n,L, ||A||op<=L s3(A) implies ||p_Q||infinity<=C_{n,L}/s3(A); any target blow-up sequence must escape dimension or normalized spectral aspect ratio.
If a universal essential-height constant is proved, the existing fixed-instance C0 representative obeys the same pointwise constant, so continuity adds no constant.

The ruled majority submeasure need not admit a continuous representative: A=diag(1,1,-1), iid Uniform[-1/2,1/2], has continuous full density p_Q with p_Q(0)=pi but majority density p_Q 1_[0,infinity) is discontinuous at zero.
